finishFindings: Official TOTO China page for TLG02301B names the model 43 times and documents NO finish/colour codes at all.
#PFG = Polished French Gold is well attested across the TOTO TLG range (dealer listings).
Nearest attested brushed gold code is #BRG = Brushed ROSE Gold — a different finish.
#BFG found in no reachable TOTO or dealer documentation.

LivLab catalogue carries both TLG02301B#BFG (Vàng Pháp Mờ) and TLG02301B#PFG (Vàng Pháp Bóng); the Mờ/Bóng pair is internally consistent with brushed/polished but is LivLab naming, not TOTO documentation.
evidence.conclusion: Resolved. TLG02301B is a GR-series single-lever lavatory faucet with pop-up waste; the GR series is offered in #BFG; and TOTO's own catalogue defines #BFG as Brushed French Gold, a PVD surface finish. TLG02301B#BFG is therefore geometry TLG02301B carrying finish #BFG, not separate geometry. Earlier searches missed this because they reached US dealer listings and the China product page, none of which carry the Asia finish legend.

finishSuffixEvidence.source: TOTO Asia official catalogue PDF (Showers 2024), finish legend p.3
finishSuffixEvidence.note: The legend heads the section 'A VARIETY OF COLORS & FINISHES' and describes these as PVD layers added on the surface. A surface layer is not a geometry variant, which is the point that was missing.

finishSuffixEvidence.source: TOTO Asia official faucet collection, GR Series row
finishSuffixEvidence.quote: GR Series / Single Lever Lavatory Faucet w/ Pop-Up Waste — Polished Chrome, Polished Nickel #PN, Brushed Nickel #BN, Polished French Gold #PFG, Brushed French Gold #BFG, Brushed Bronze #BBR
finishSuffixEvidence.note: The first product in the GR row is the single-lever lavatory faucet with pop-up waste, which is what TLG02301B is: the TOTO China page calls it GR系列 and states 排水配件：已配.

evidence.supersedes: Earlier finding that #BFG was unattested and that #BRG (Brushed Rose Gold) was the nearest brushed gold code. #BFG is a real TOTO finish code; the earlier sources simply did not list it.

officialDimensions.source: TOTO China official dimensional drawing size_x.jpg (300dpi), linked from the product page
officialDimensions.widthNote: NOT DIMENSIONED by the manufacturer. The drawing gives height (133.2) and spout reach (117.2) only; the body is a slim cylinder and no width figure is published. cad.dwg is 2D-only (0 3D entities) and carries no extractable width. Width therefore cannot be QA-scored against manufacturer data and must not be invented.
officialDimensions.bboxScopeWarning: Supply hoses (394mm) and the pop-up drain assembly (202/285mm) are BELOW-COUNTER accessories. The official page states 排水配件：已配 (drain included), so the archive may contain them. They must be excluded from the Room Studio bbox or the height QA will be wrong by a factor of ~4.

catalogDimensionConflict.note: Catalogue record carries no dimensions (empty), so manufacturer figures fill a gap rather than contradict one. No CATALOG_DIMENSION_CONFLICT.

placement.evidence: Official product name 台式 (deck-mounted) 单孔 (single hole), and the drawing's Ø35 mounting hole with max 53.5mm deck thickness.
placement.catalogAdapterMismatch: lib/room-studio/productAdapter derives placementType 'wall' for this product. That is wrong for a deck-mounted faucet; it should be counter-based. Reported, not changed — it is a shared code path affecting every faucet.
